description: For a file with more than one version (list_files shows a file's `versions`): shows the open comments of an older version each beside the same spot in a newer one, so you can tell which comments the newer version took care of. Each picture has the older version on the left with the comment's numbered pin, and the newer version on the right with a dashed ring where the pin was; the spot is the same page or video moment, at the same place in percent. By default the latest version against the one before it. Comments stay on the version they were made on: resolve the ones that are taken care of with resolve_feedback (only when the user asks), by their id. Six comments per call; continue with `offset`.

fileId.description: Any version of the file: an id from list_files or its versions

from.description: The older version, by number (default: the one before `to`)

offset.description: Start at this comment (the last call's nextOffset)

project.description: The project, by name or id from list_projects. Only needed when the token reaches several projects

to.description: The newer version, by number (default: the latest)

name: compare_versions
title: Compare versions of a file
